summary: TSharpVision 1.2.0 is the display and graphics release: runtime Color/BlackWhite/Monochrome palette switching, physical palettes and display effects on the SDL GPU driver, and the new optional TSharpVision.Graphics package for pixel graphics and decoded RGBA images.
changes: Runtime switching between the Color, BlackWhite and Monochrome palette families (TProgram.SetAppPalette) and live colour-dialog preview.
SDLGpuDriver physical palettes (Default, Green, Amber, Grayscale) and display effects (Default, Scanlines, Glow, Curvature, ShadowMask); one effect at a time.

New optional package TSharpVision.Graphics (depends only on TSharpVision): GView/GWindow display lists, shapes, PixelImage/GImage with nearest or linear filtering; pixels with TSharpVision.Drivers.SDL, text fallback elsewhere.
TVDemo: STYX graphics, Graphics gallery and Live chart.
Built-in framework translations with runtime language switching, Help search across several help files, and a session-only file-dialog directory.
The command-line tools svrc, svhc and svres are published as the .NET tool packages TSharpVision.ResourceCompiler, TSharpVision.HelpCompiler and TSharpVision.ResourceTools.
compatibility: Additive public API; the 1.0 and 1.1 declarations are retained. Package validation compares the eight established packages with 1.1.0; TSharpVision.Graphics and the three tool packages are new package IDs without a baseline.
scope: Display and graphics release; see CHANGELOG.md section 1.2.0.
readme_summary: display and graphics release with SDL GPU palettes and effects, the optional TSharpVision.Graphics package, and the svrc, svhc and svres command-line tools as .NET tool packages.
